claim: Functional equivalence only at partial frozen snapshot; no performance or final acceptance. Original raw probe exit1 preserved; ten mismatches are only trajectory revision metadata.
canonicalHashMethod: SHA256 of UTF-8 Python JSON: ensure_ascii=false, sort_keys=true, separators comma/colon, finite numbers. Raw and normalized hashes use this same deterministic encoding. Only tr.revision is removed for revision normalization; eligibility, observations and PNG hashes are unchanged.
pngHashMethod: Per-frame pngDataURLSHA256 was computed by the browser probe as SHA256 of Canvas.toDataURL() string, a one-to-one encoding of actual PNG bytes. Eight saved hold-frame PNG pairs additionally have binary-byte SHA256 in png-binary-receipt.json.

rawEvidence.retention: Raw and gzip remain scratch only; do not add to git.

reproduce: Use compact-receipt.py against scratch report.json to regenerate hashes. probe.cjs --snapshot then probe.cjs reproduces browser audit at matching source hashes; negative.cjs and full-path.cjs reproduce dedicated checks. Browser needs JIZURA_BROWSER=/usr/bin/chromium and local network/socket permissions. Original probe is intentionally retained, including raw revision mismatch behavior.

revisionMismatchEvidence.reason: Font metrics revision advances naturally when new text/language materializes glyphs between runs. Compare trajectory revision to its own metrics revision; preserve raw failures. Only tr.revision is normalized, all placement/attempt/eligibility/PNG/polygon content remains exact.
